---
name: Skill request
about: Suggest a new skill, template, rubric item or check
title: "request: "
labels: enhancement
---

**What should it do?** (one sentence)

**What would someone say to trigger it?** (2–3 natural phrases, e.g. "translate my survey into Spanish")

**Input → output** (what you give it, what you get back)

**Category:** create / validate / improve / ship / not sure

**Why it matters** (the problem it solves; for a rubric item or check, include evidence that it affects response rate or data quality)

**Example** (a survey excerpt or a link, anonymised)

**Works for any survey tool?** Skills here are tool-agnostic (Google Forms, Typeform, SurveyMonkey, Qualtrics, paper, BlockSurvey…). Describe the tool-agnostic version.
